The Ryley showcases the thoughtful design and functionality today's homeowners are looking for, offering 2,770 square feet, 4 bedrooms, and 2.5 baths. From the covered front porch, step into an open-concept layout designed for everyday living and entertaining. Expansive windows allow natural light to flow throughout the main level, while the versatile flex room near the foyer can be personalized to fit your lifestyle as a home office, fitness space, playroom, or den. The spacious kitchen opens to the main living area, creating a seamless connection between gathering spaces. Upstairs, all four bedrooms are thoughtfully positioned to maximize privacy, including a spacious primary suite and convenient second-floor laundry. Designed with flexibility, storage, and livability in mind, the Ryley can be personalized with a variety of structural and design options to reflect your personal style.
